name: ZX Spectrum 48K ROM
provenance: spectrum48_rom_entry_points.md (TS2068 Ref Library) — documented entry points

16.name: PRINT-A
16.note: Write char in A to current output stream (`JP PRINT-A-2`)

28.name: TEST-CHAR
28.note: Test if char is relevant (called by GET-CHAR)

32.name: NEXT-CHAR
32.note: Advance CH_ADD, fetch next char → A

48.name: BC-SPACES
48.note: Create BC free bytes in workspace

56.name: MASK-INT
56.note: Maskable interrupt: increment FRAMES, call KEYBOARD

83.name: ERROR-2
83.note: Pop return addr → error code; `LD ERR_NR,L`; restore SP; `JP SET-STK`

85.name: ERROR-3
85.note: As ERROR-2 but L already holds error code (no pop)

102.name: RESET
102.note: NMI handler. Checks NMIADD ($5CB0); inverted-logic bug — see note

116.name: CH-ADD+1
116.note: Increment CH_ADD, return new char in A

120.name: TEMP-PTR2
120.note: Store HL → CH_ADD; load A ← (HL); return

125.name: SKIP-OVER
125.note: Skip embedded control codes $10–$17; return NC if char is printable

517.name: MAIN-KEYS
517.note: 39-byte unshifted key table (B H Y 6 5 T G V … Q A)

608.name: CTL-CODES
608.note: 10 control codes for CAPS+digit (DELETE, EDIT, CAPS LOCK…)

644.name: E-DIGITS
644.note: 10 extended+digit codes (FORMAT, DEF FN, FN, LINE…)

654.name: KEY-SCAN
654.note: Scan all 8 half-rows; return raw reading

703.name: KEYBOARD
703.note: Full keyboard scan: debounce, decode, update KSTATE/LASTK

819.name: K-DECODE
819.note: Decode raw row/column → character code using tables above

949.name: BEEPER
949.note: Low-level tone generator. Toggles EAR bit (port $FE) at precise timing

1016.name: beep
1016.note: BEEP command: convert BASIC pitch/duration params, call BEEPER

1218.name: SA-BYTES
1218.note: Save a block of bytes to tape

1287.name: SA-START
1287.note: Start of byte loop (entry inside SA-BYTES)

1343.name: SA/LD-RET
1343.note: Common return point for SAVE and LOAD

1366.name: LD-BYTES
1366.note: Load a block of bytes from tape

1882.name: SA-ALL
1882.note: Build tape header and save program/data

3035.name: PO-ATTR
3035.note: Set display attributes from ATTRP/ATTRT for current print position

3435.name: CLS
3435.note: Clear entire screen (calls CL-ALL then resets DFSZ)

3545.name: CL-SET
3545.note: Set up display file pointers (DFCC, DFCCL)

3584.name: CL-SCROLL
3584.note: Scroll screen up one line. B=number of lines to scroll

4264.name: KEY-INPUT
4264.note: Process a keypress in editor context

4535.name: NEW
4535.note: NEW command: jump to START-NEW with A=$FF (warm start)

5009.name: rpt-mesgs
5009.note: Report message text table (OK, NEXT without FOR, etc.)

5588.name: WAIT-KEY
5588.note: Wait for a key, return char in A

5714.name: ONE-SPACE
5714.note: Create 1 free byte in workspace (calls MAKE-ROOM with BC=1)

5717.name: MAKE-ROOM
5717.note: Insert BC bytes at HL; updates all pointers above HL

5732.name: POINTERS
5732.note: Update system pointers after memory insertion/deletion

5790.name: RESERVE
5790.note: Allocate BC bytes in workspace above WORKSP; called by BC-SPACES (RST $30)

5808.name: SET-MIN
5808.note: Reset workspace to minimum: clear vars, reset STKBOT/STKEND/MEM

5829.name: SET-STK
5829.note: Reset calculator stack and MEM pointer; JP to error recovery

6935.name: LINE-SCAN
6935.note: Scan and syntax-check (or execute) one BASIC statement

6952.name: STMT-LOOP
6952.note: Statement loop: fetch and execute statements

6997.name: GET-PARAM
6997.note: Get class-code parameters for current command

7050.name: LINE-RUN
7050.note: Execute BASIC line in RUN mode

8141.name: LPRINT
8141.note: LPRINT command (sets PR flag then falls into PRINT)

8907.name: POINT-SUB
8907.note: Test if pixel at (C,B) is set; result on calc stack

8924.name: PLOT
8924.note: PLOT command: plot pixel at screen coordinates

9467.name: SCANNING
9467.note: Evaluate expression; result pushed onto calculator stack

9923.name: S-NUMERIC
9923.note: Signal that expression result is numeric (sets FLAGS bit 6)

10418.name: LOOK-VARS
10418.note: Look up a variable in the VARS area

11007.name: LET
11007.note: LET command: assign expression to variable

11249.name: STK-FETCH
11249.note: Fetch string descriptor from calculator stack → BC=length, DE=address

11266.name: DIM
11266.note: DIM command: create numeric or string array

11560.name: STACK-A
11560.note: Push value in A onto calculator stack as float

11563.name: STACK-BC
11563.note: Push 16-bit value in BC onto calculator stack as integer float

11579.name: INT-TO-FP
11579.note: Convert integer in DE/HL to 5-byte float

11682.name: FP-TO-BC
11682.note: Pop top of calculator stack → BC (integer, must fit 16 bits)

11733.name: FP-TO-A
11733.note: Pop top of calculator stack → A (integer 0–255)

11747.name: PRINT-FP
11747.note: Print floating-point number on calculator stack to current channel

13147.name: CALCULATE
13147.note: Calculator entry point — same as RST $28 target

13150.name: GEN-ENT-1
13150.note: Internal calculator entry used for recursive calls
